unlisted_practices: Prespecify routing thresholds and a gray zone for abstention or escalation of uncertain AI outputs to human review.
Require AI systems to communicate calibrated, task-appropriate uncertainty to users.
Pre-register a statistical analysis plan for evaluating human-AI team performance.
Evaluate human-AI teams longitudinally to capture changes in trust and clinician skill decay.
Follow reporting standards such as CONSORT-AI, TRIPOD-AI, and SPIRIT-AI and align with NIST AI RMF, ISO 14971, and IEC 62304.
